subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar tossed a bone die onto Glabbagool, triggering a mysterious 'blink' that caused the oozes to become mindless and peaceful.
source_quote: Jimjar tosses a bone die onto Glabbagool, triggering a mysterious 'blink' that causes the oozes to become mindless and peaceful.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool briefly connected with the entire ooze horde telepathically, telling them to calm down, leading the mass of jellies and puddings to slither away into the stonework.
source_quote: Glabbagool briefly connects with the entire ooze horde telepathically, telling them to calm down, leading the mass of jellies and puddings to slither away into the stonework.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is immune to poison and psychic damage, cannot be charmed or frightened, and is resistant to radiant damage and non-magical physical attacks.
source_quote: Zalthir uses a special ability to discern Jimjar's resistances and immunities, discovering he is immune to poison and psychic damage, cannot be charmed or frightened, and is resistant to radiant damage and non-magical physical attacks.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar winks at the party and vanishes into thin air, heading back toward Blingdenstone.
source_quote: Realizing he has been scrutinized, Jimjar winks at the party and vanishes into thin air, heading back toward Blingdenstone.

subject: Jimjar's true nature
fact: Jimjar may be a deity or celestial being, as his stat block resembles that of an angel, but this is not confirmed in this session.
source_quote: The party discusses the possibility of Jimjar being a deity or celestial being, noting his stat block resembles that of an angel.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz delivered a motivational speech urging the factions to set aside their egos for a mutual alliance and economic renaissance.
source_quote: Daz delivers a motivational speech urging the factions to set aside their egos for a mutual alliance and economic renaissance.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin successfully points out the exact location of the psychic center in the Hall of Melting Mirrors.
source_quote: Thorin, using a bit of luck and unexpected intuition, successfully points out the exact location of the psychic center.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum casts a powerful healing spell that restores the Earth Elemental's structural integrity.
source_quote: Grygum casts a powerful healing spell that restores the elemental's structural integrity.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum pays Jimjar the ten platinum pieces from the party funds for successfully neutralizing the threat.
source_quote: Grygum pays Jimjar the ten platinum pieces from the party funds for successfully neutralizing the threat.

subject: Chipgrin
fact: Chipgrin presents Daz with a braided rat's foot Voucher of the Varmint as a sign of friendship with the wererats.
source_quote: Chief Chipgrin presents Daz with a braided rat's foot Voucher of the Varmint as a sign of friendship with the wererats.

subject: Diggermattock
fact: Chief Diggermattock and Chipgrin begin arguing over how to divide the territory even as the oozes threaten to overrun them.
source_quote: Chief Diggermattock and Chipgrin begin arguing over how to divide the territory even as the oozes threaten to overrun them.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin attempts to persuade the leaders to focus on the immediate threat, though the argument initially continues.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar explains the origin of the bone die, claiming he won it from a blind Duergar in Gracklstugh and that it was carved from a saint's knucklebone.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool describes briefly being part of one big mind with all the oozes before they returned to their mindless states.
source_quote: The party asks Glabbagool about the experience; he describes briefly being part of one big mind with all the oozes before they returned to their mindless states.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar returns Grygum's ten platinum winnings and warns of a new fungal threat — a pale white puffball mushroom growing at impossible speed from a crack in the wall, smelling sweetly of rot.

subject: Daz

subject: Daz

subject: Thorin

subject: Grygum

subject: Jimjar
